meanings.en: loss of physical sensation or feeling
meanings.exampleEn: A strange numbness spread through her fingers in the cold.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğukta parmaklarına garip bir uyuşukluk yayıldı.

meanings.en: the act of connecting or becoming a member
meanings.exampleEn: The joining of the two pipes required a special seal.
meanings.exampleTr: İki borunun birleştirilmesi özel bir conta gerektirdi.

meanings.en: a series of things or people following one after another
meanings.exampleEn: A succession of storms hit the coast that winter.
meanings.exampleTr: O kış sahile ardı ardına fırtınalar vurdu.

meanings.en: a period of being seated, especially for a meal or meeting
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant serves dinner in two sittings each evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran her akşam yemeği iki oturumda servis ediyor.

meanings.en: to make someone anxious or uneasy
meanings.exampleEn: The strange noise began to unsettle the whole class.
meanings.exampleTr: Garip ses bütün sınıfı tedirgin etmeye başladı.

meanings.en: a territory controlled by a distant country or a group of organisms
meanings.exampleEn: The country was once a British colony.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke bir zamanlar bir İngiliz sömürgesiydi.

meanings.en: a person who settles in a new colony
meanings.exampleEn: The early colonists struggled to survive the harsh winter.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk yerleşimciler sert kışta hayatta kalmak için mücadele etti.

meanings.en: a person who is among the first to explore or develop something
meanings.exampleEn: She was a pioneer in the field of computer science.
meanings.exampleTr: O, bilgisayar bilimi alanında bir öncüydü.

meanings.en: to a small degree; gently
meanings.exampleEn: He was mildly surprised by the sudden change of plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Planın ani değişiminden biraz şaşırmıştı.

meanings.en: existing only on the surface; lacking depth
meanings.exampleEn: His knowledge of the subject was only superficial.
meanings.exampleTr: Konu hakkındaki bilgisi yalnızca yüzeyseldi.

meanings.en: high respect; a quality of integrity and dignity
meanings.exampleEn: It was a great honour to receive the award.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü almak büyük bir onurdu.

meanings.en: shockingly unacceptable; shameful
meanings.exampleEn: Their behaviour at the dinner was absolutely disgraceful.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemekteki davranışları kesinlikle utanç vericiydi.

meanings.en: bringing shame or disgrace; lacking honour
meanings.exampleEn: He was discharged from the army for dishonourable conduct.
meanings.exampleTr: Onursuz davranışı nedeniyle ordudan ihraç edildi.

meanings.en: having a sharp end; or directed pointedly at someone
meanings.exampleEn: She made a pointed remark about his lateness.
meanings.exampleTr: Geç kalması hakkında iğneleyici bir yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: a law-enforcement officer, especially a sheriff
meanings.exampleEn: The old lawman had kept order in the town for decades.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı kanun adamı onlarca yıl boyunca kasabada düzeni sağlamıştı.

meanings.en: a high-ranking officer or an official who maintains order
meanings.exampleEn: The marshal organized the parade route carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Görevli geçit töreni güzergahını dikkatle düzenledi.

meanings.en: smooth and shiny
meanings.exampleEn: The magazine was printed on glossy paper.
meanings.exampleTr: Dergi parlak kağıda basılmıştı.

meanings.en: having a dull, non-shiny surface
meanings.exampleEn: She chose a matte finish for the walls.
meanings.exampleTr: Duvarlar için mat bir kaplama seçti.

meanings.en: to tremble suddenly from fear, cold, or disgust
meanings.exampleEn: She began to shudder at the thought of the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaza düşüncesiyle ürpermeye başladı.

meanings.en: so shocked or surprised that one cannot react
meanings.exampleEn: He was stunned by the unexpected news.
meanings.exampleTr: Beklenmedik haber karşısında afallamıştı.

meanings.en: deeply shocked and dismayed
meanings.exampleEn: We were appalled by the condition of the building.
meanings.exampleTr: Binanın durumu karşısında dehşete düşmüştük.

meanings.en: not affected emotionally; indifferent
meanings.exampleEn: She remained unmoved by his desperate plea.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun çaresiz yalvarışından etkilenmedi.

meanings.en: causing shock or dismay; horrific
meanings.exampleEn: The living conditions in the camp were appalling.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamptaki yaşam koşulları korkunçtu.

meanings.en: very surprising or unexpected
meanings.exampleEn: The report revealed some startling statistics.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor bazı şaşırtıcı istatistikler ortaya koydu.

meanings.en: not interesting or surprising; ordinary
meanings.exampleEn: It was an unremarkable little town with one main street.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek caddesi olan sıradan, küçük bir kasabaydı.

meanings.en: a sign or piece of information that suggests something
meanings.exampleEn: There was no indication that the machine was faulty.
meanings.exampleTr: Makinenin arızalı olduğuna dair hiçbir belirti yoktu.

meanings.en: a famous person's signature given as a keepsake
meanings.exampleEn: The fans waited for hours to get the singer's autograph.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayranlar şarkıcının imzasını almak için saatlerce bekledi.

meanings.en: the quality of being unimportant or too small to matter
meanings.exampleEn: The vast desert made him feel his own insignificance.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçsuz bucaksız çöl ona kendi önemsizliğini hissettirdi.

meanings.en: an object or sign used to indicate a position or feature
meanings.exampleEn: A stone marker showed the boundary of the field.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir taş işaret tarlanın sınırını gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: the state of being similar to something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kız kardeş arasında güçlü bir benzerlik var.

meanings.en: at the same time; simultaneously
meanings.exampleEn: The two projects were run concurrently to save time.
meanings.exampleTr: İki proje zamandan tasarruf etmek için eş zamanlı olarak yürütüldü.

meanings.en: one after another in unbroken order
meanings.exampleEn: The pages are numbered consecutively from one to fifty.
meanings.exampleTr: Sayfalar birden elliye kadar art arda numaralandırılmıştır.

meanings.en: the hard pieces that form the skeleton of a body
meanings.exampleEn: The dog buried its bones in the garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek kemiklerini bahçeye gömdü.

meanings.en: the outer protective layer of the skin
meanings.exampleEn: The epidermis acts as a barrier against infection.
meanings.exampleTr: Epidermis enfeksiyona karşı bir bariyer görevi görür.

meanings.en: having many storeys; tall (of a building)
meanings.exampleEn: They moved into a high-rise apartment downtown.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezinde çok katlı bir daireye taşındılar.

meanings.en: the state of being a slave or held in subjection
meanings.exampleEn: The people were freed from years of bondage.
meanings.exampleTr: Halk yıllarca süren esaretten kurtuldu.

meanings.en: the state of being under the control of another; slavery
meanings.exampleEn: They lived in servitude under a cruel master.
meanings.exampleTr: Zalim bir efendinin altında kölelik içinde yaşadılar.

meanings.en: sleep, especially light or peaceful sleep
meanings.exampleEn: The baby fell into a deep slumber after the feeding.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebek beslendikten sonra derin bir uykuya daldı.

meanings.en: the state of being awake
meanings.exampleEn: Too much coffee can cause prolonged wakefulness at night.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok fazla kahve geceleri uzun süreli uyanıklığa neden olabilir.

meanings.en: a small amount or to a small degree
meanings.exampleEn: Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen biraz daha yavaş konuşabilir misiniz?

meanings.en: a well-known phrase associated with a person or product
meanings.exampleEn: The comedian's catchphrase became popular nationwide.
meanings.exampleTr: Komedyenin akılda kalıcı sözü ülke çapında popüler oldu.

meanings.en: a slope or sloping surface
meanings.exampleEn: The cyclists struggled up the steep incline.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisikletçiler dik yokuşu zorlukla çıktı.

meanings.en: the degree of slope of a surface or road
meanings.exampleEn: The road has a steep gradient near the summit.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolun zirveye yakın kısmında dik bir eğim var.

meanings.en: a person who does not smoke
meanings.exampleEn: As a nonsmoker, she asked for a seat away from the smoking area.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigara içmeyen biri olarak, sigara içilen alandan uzak bir koltuk istedi.

meanings.en: a severe snowstorm with strong winds
meanings.exampleEn: The blizzard closed all the roads for two days.
meanings.exampleTr: Tipi tüm yolları iki gün boyunca kapattı.

meanings.en: in some way or manner; somehow
meanings.exampleEn: We will finish the project someway before the deadline.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi son tarihten önce bir şekilde bitireceğiz.

meanings.en: to make someone troubled or to stir something vigorously
meanings.exampleEn: The bad news began to agitate the waiting crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü haber bekleyen kalabalığı tedirgin etmeye başladı.

meanings.en: suffering a continuous dull pain
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, my aching legs needed a rest.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra ağrıyan bacaklarımın dinlenmeye ihtiyacı vardı.

meanings.en: having a sharp, sour taste
meanings.exampleEn: The lemon sauce was a little too tart for my liking.
meanings.exampleTr: Limon sosu benim zevkime göre biraz fazla ekşiydi.

meanings.en: having the properties of an acid; sour
meanings.exampleEn: Citrus fruits have a strongly acidic taste.
meanings.exampleTr: Turunçgillerin güçlü bir asitli tadı vardır.

meanings.en: a small item kept in memory of a person or event
meanings.exampleEn: She kept the ring as a keepsake from her grandmother.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzüğü büyükannesinden bir hatıra olarak sakladı.

meanings.en: an object kept as a reminder of a person or event
meanings.exampleEn: He bought a small statue as a memento of his trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezisinin bir hatırası olarak küçük bir heykel aldı.

meanings.en: to shine with a bright, sparkling light
meanings.exampleEn: The stars seemed to glitter in the clear night sky.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıldızlar açık gece gökyüzünde ışıldıyor gibiydi.

meanings.en: a person with broad knowledge across many fields
meanings.exampleEn: In a small company, a generalist can handle many roles.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük bir şirkette, çok yönlü biri birçok rolü üstlenebilir.

meanings.en: a person who watches something without taking part
meanings.exampleEn: A crowd of onlookers gathered around the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazanın etrafında bir grup seyirci toplandı.

meanings.en: the conventional spelling system of a language
meanings.exampleEn: English orthography is notoriously difficult for learners.
meanings.exampleTr: İngilizce imlası öğrenenler için son derece zordur.

meanings.en: salt, herbs, or spices added to food for flavour
meanings.exampleEn: The soup needs a bit more seasoning.
meanings.exampleTr: Çorbanın biraz daha baharata ihtiyacı var.

meanings.en: having a pleasantly sharp or spicy taste
meanings.exampleEn: The dish had a piquant sauce that woke up the palate.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemekte damağı uyandıran keskin bir sos vardı.

meanings.en: lacking strong flavour or interest
meanings.exampleEn: The meal was rather bland and needed more salt.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemek oldukça yavandı ve daha fazla tuza ihtiyacı vardı.

meanings.en: wound into a series of loops or rings
meanings.exampleEn: The snake lay coiled beneath the rock.
meanings.exampleTr: Yılan kayanın altında kıvrılmış halde yatıyordu.

meanings.en: the confidence and enthusiasm of a person or group
meanings.exampleEn: The team's morale improved after the big win.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük galibiyetten sonra takımın morali yükseldi.

meanings.en: a person who supports or finances a project
meanings.exampleEn: The startup found a wealthy backer for its new product.
meanings.exampleTr: Girişim, yeni ürünü için zengin bir finansör buldu.

meanings.en: likely to change or fall; not steady
meanings.exampleEn: The old ladder felt unstable under his weight.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski merdiven onun ağırlığı altında dengesiz hissettiriyordu.

meanings.en: to stare with one's mouth open in surprise
meanings.exampleEn: The children could only gape at the enormous whale.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar devasa balinaya ancak ağzı açık bakabildiler.

meanings.en: in a steady, unchanging manner over time
meanings.exampleEn: She consistently produces high-quality work.
meanings.exampleTr: O, sürekli olarak yüksek kaliteli işler ortaya koyar.

meanings.en: in an irregular, unpredictable way
meanings.exampleEn: The old engine ran erratically and often stalled.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski motor düzensizce çalışıyor ve sık sık stop ediyordu.

meanings.en: a substance suspended in air as a gas or mist
meanings.exampleEn: Water vapor rose from the hot spring.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaplıcadan su buharı yükseliyordu.

meanings.en: a design or sticker transferred onto a surface
meanings.exampleEn: He stuck a racing decal on the side of his car.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabasının yan tarafına bir yarış çıkartması yapıştırdı.

meanings.en: sticky like glue
meanings.exampleEn: The melted candy left a gluey mess on the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Erimiş şeker masada yapışkan bir karmaşa bıraktı.

meanings.en: slightly sticky to the touch; or cheap and tasteless
meanings.exampleEn: The paint was still tacky when she touched it.
meanings.exampleTr: Boya dokunduğunda hâlâ yapış yapıştı.
